reviewer_note: Independent adversarial review. Every verdict below rests on pages opened today at official locations (Publications Office cellar copies of OJ texts, Commission pages, OEIL, CEN-CENELEC and national standards body catalogues). EUR-Lex itself returned empty content to WebFetch for every URL pattern tried; the cellar serves the same OJ and consolidated documents. WebFetch extracts through a small model with a 125-character quote cap, so long provisions were confirmed as sequences of short exact quotes, and every load-bearing wording (Art. 77(1), 77(3), 77(9), 13(1), 13(4), 13(5), 13(6)) was obtained from two separate documents or two separate fetches.

checked.claim: Battery passport applies from 18 February 2027 to each LMT battery, each industrial battery with a capacity greater than 2 kWh and each EV battery placed on the market or put into service (per individual battery; threshold is strictly greater than and applies to industrial batteries only).

evidence.what_it_shows: Consolidated text 02023R1542 - EN - 13.08.2026 - 003.001 (offset 400000): Art. 77(1) quoted verbatim: 'From 18 February 2027 each LMT battery, each industrial battery with a capacity greater than 2 kWh' / 'and each electric vehicle battery placed on the market or put into service shall have an electronic record' / "('battery passport')".
Original OJ L 191 text (offset 650000): identical Art. 77(1) wording obtained as a second route.
Commission news of 21 August 2026 restates: from 18 February 2027 each EV, LMT and industrial battery over 2 kWh placed on the market or put into service must have a battery passport.

checked.notes: Wording check: 'greater than' (not 'at least'); 'each' (per individual battery); both triggers 'placed on the market or put into service'; capacity qualifier attaches to 'industrial battery' only. Art. 77(1) says 'industrial battery', not 'rechargeable industrial battery' - unlike Art. 7(1), 8(1) and 10(1), which say 'rechargeable industrial batteries with a capacity greater than 2 kWh'. A non-rechargeable industrial battery above 2 kWh therefore falls inside Art. 77(1) but outside Art. 10(1); see claim 12.
